description: Every [PATH-X] and [PATH-X-Y] tagged decision node, extracted from its source file. Each node keeps its original ID so a chosen pattern traces back to source. Only 10 of the 7 reference files' decision points carry an explicit PATH- tag (unlike vois-tokens' DS- corpus, which tags nearly every rule) — the remaining untagged IF/THEN branches, worked examples, and righter-routing call-outs stay in the reference .md files. microcopy-routing.md and permissions-and-conditional-logic.md carry no PATH- tags at all (cross-cutting guidance, not a per-template decision tree) and are not represented here.

nodes.condition: User is managing profile, workspace, team, billing, notifications, or members. Multiple related sections that don't need to be edited simultaneously. Changes persist immediately or on explicit save.
nodes.outcome: Use the Settings Page pattern. Depth (shallow vs. deep) is decided by PATH-A-DEPTH-SHALLOW / PATH-A-DEPTH-DEEP. Mobile: sidebar becomes a hamburger menu that slides out and overlaps content.
Horizontal tabs pinned to top (single page). Structure: page title + tabs + tab content area.
Sidebar navigation + sub-pages. Structure: sidebar (pinned on desktop, hamburger on mobile) + main content area.

nodes.condition: User needs to browse, search, filter, and act on multiple items. User occasionally dives into single item details. Bulk actions might be needed.
nodes.outcome: Use the Table/List with Details pattern. Details container: quick edit needed (checkboxes, sliders, dropdowns, a handful of fields) → right sidebar, edit-focused. Viewing details first (default view state, might edit after) → modal, view-focused, with an "Edit" action that navigates to a dedicated form page.

nodes.condition: User is creating a new item, editing an existing item, or completing a workflow/multi-step process.
nodes.outcome: Use the Form pattern. Complexity (simple/medium/complex) is decided by field count via PATH-C-SIMPLE / PATH-C-MEDIUM / PATH-C-COMPLEX.
Single column, stack vertically. No grouping needed. Space between fields: 24px (spacing-md in vois-tokens).
Single column OR 2 columns. Group related inputs with section headers (e.g. an address group: street, city, state, zip). Space within section: 24px between fields, 40px between sections.
Tabs OR 2 columns with sections. Group related fields under section headers (e.g. event creation: left = basic info, right = advanced settings).

nodes.condition: Single quick input needed (amount, selection, confirmation). Simple confirmation (yes/no, approve/reject). Dropdown selection, especially on mobile.
nodes.outcome: Desktop: modal dialog, centered, backdrop dims content behind. Mobile: action sheet, slides up from bottom, covers 80-90% screen height for multi-step. Never use an action sheet if text input/keyboard is required — that needs a full modal. Footer button placement: primary right, secondary 20px left of primary, optional tertiary on the left.

nodes.condition: User is viewing a single record in read-only mode. No editing at this level (editing happens on a dedicated form page). User might click through to edit on a separate page.
nodes.outcome: Header: breadcrumb above H1 title, close/back button top right if in a modal. Body: groups of related data stacked vertically, each group as label + value, status indicators/badges where relevant. Actions: no primary action in view-only state; an "Edit" link/button navigates to the form page if editing is available. Mobile: stacked single column, no horizontal grouping.
